Data.subject: Public Sector
Data.title: Workload Statistics Of Supreme Court, State Courts And Family Justice Courts, Annual
Data.footnote: The number of cases disposed in a year can exceed the number of cases filed in a year as the number of cases disposed of in any year are not a subset of the cases filed in that year.  Please refer to the Sustainable Development Goals (SDG) Global Metadata (https://unstats.un.org/sdgs/metadata) for more information on SDG 16.3.3.

row.rowText: State Courts - Number Of Cases Filed (Criminal Cases)
row.footnote: Data for Criminal Cases comprise: i. Criminal charges (including DAC, MAC, PSS, PS & other charges), ii. Departmental or Statutory Board charges and summonses, iii. Traffic charges and summonses, iv. Coroner's Court cases, v. Non-Relational Magistrate's Complaints

row.rowText: State Courts - Number Of Cases Filed (Civil Cases)
row.footnote: Data for Civil Cases comprise: i. Originating Processes, ii. Interlocutory Applications, iii. Taxations, iv. Assessment of Damages

row.rowText: State Courts - Number Of Cases Filed (Civil Cases) (Originating Processes)
row.footnote: Data for Originating Processes comprise: i. Writs of Summons and Originating Claims (Writ of Summons is called Originating Claim under the Rules of Court 2021 with effect from 1 April 2022.); and ii. Originating Summonses and Originating Applications (Originating Summons is called Originating Application under the Rules of Court 2021, with effect from 1 April 2022.). Data are used for SDG 16.3.3 'Proportion of the population who have experienced a dispute in the past two years and who accessed a formal or informal dispute resolution mechanism, by type of mechanism'.

row.rowText: State Courts - Number Of Cases Filed (Community Courts And Tribunals Cases)
row.footnote: Data for Community Justice and Tribunals Cases comprise : i. Community Disputes Resolution Tribunals (CDRT) claims, ii. Employment Claims Tribunals (ECT) claims, iii. Relational Magistrate's Complaints, iv. Protection from Harassment Court (PHC) cases, v. Small Claims Tribunals (SCT) claims. Data are used for SDG 16.3.3 'Proportion of the population who have experienced a dispute in the past two years and who accessed a formal or informal dispute resolution mechanism, by type of mechanism'.

Refers to fresh cases handled by the Court Dispute Resolution cluster and is not included in the State Courts' caseload statistics.
